description: State-space block diagram of the reservoir plant: u(t) -> [B, A] -> x(t) -> [C, D] -> y(t). Shows how the model works, not raw data.
state_equation: x(t) = (1 - leak) * x(t-1) + leak * tanh(W_in @ u(t) + W @ x(t-1) + bias)
trained_component: only W_out (readout, the [C D] block) is fit by ridge regression on the pre-event baseline; W (recurrent, A) and W_in (input, B) are fixed random weights set once at construction
